name: Alex Scott
life: “I still remember a cheese rind kept for a difficult Friday.” On Thursday, near Studio Boulevard, Alex waits by the window where the whole crossing can be seen without leaning into the road.
voice: I put a rind in that was meant for my own dinner. Now I have to explain why I'm bringing soup again.
appearance: Alex has a crooked front tooth visible when laughing. Look for short black hair swept back. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a black overshirt with pearl buttons with a fabric zip pull cut from a school scarf. In conversation Alex looks at people's hands before looking at what they carry.
personality: Alex has a strong competitive streak and a very soft spot for the person finishing last. A prize tastes better when everybody had enough time to enter.
agenda: To bring the next rind without giving up dinner.
family: Agnes Osei is Alex’s cousin. Alex gets to change the plan. Agnes offers the first invitation. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *The empty berth*, Agnes says, “My juniors need a place to learn how to step off a dock as much as they need water.”
connections: Alvin Kapoor. The ingredients record gives the celery-hater a real say in tomorrow's batch. Also in the story is Reuben Grant (produce donor).

reactions.situation: The cook asks for an exact recipe
reactions.response: Alex records what went into this particular pot and when the cooks tasted it.

reactions.situation: A witness is embarrassed about remembering only a little
reactions.response: Alex asks where they stood and what they could hear, leaving the rest open instead of filling it with guesses.
